arxiv-2202-00930.title: Machine learning based prediction of the electronic structure of quasi-one-dimensional materials under strain
arxiv-2202-00930.creator: Shashank Pathrudkar, Hsuan Ming Yu, Susanta Ghosh, Amartya S. Banerjee
arxiv-2202-00930.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Shashank Pathrudkar, Hsuan Ming Yu, Susanta Ghosh, Amartya S. Banerjee. We present a machine learning based model that can predict the electronic structure of quasi–one–dimensional materials while they are subjected to deformation modes such as torsion and extension/compression.

arxiv-2411-12607.title: Single-fluid simulation of partially-ionized, non-ideal plasma facilitated by a tabulated equation of state
arxiv-2411-12607.creator: G. Su, S. T. Millmore, X. Zhang, N. Nikiforakis
arxiv-2411-12607.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by G. Su, S. T. Millmore, X. Zhang, N. Nikiforakis. We present a single-fluid approach for the simulation of partially-ionized plasmas (PIPs) which is designed to capture the non-ideal effects introduced by neutrals while remaining close in computational efficiency to single-fluid MHD. This is achieved using a model which treats the entire partially-ionized plasma as a single mixture, which renders internal ionization/recombination source terms unnecessary as both the charged and neutral species are part of the mixture’s conservative system.

arxiv-2509-26462.title: Zero-shot Decentralized Federated Learning
arxiv-2509-26462.creator: Alessio Masano, Matteo Pennisi, Federica Proietto Salanitri, Concetto Spampinato, Giovanni Bellitto
arxiv-2509-26462.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Alessio Masano, Matteo Pennisi, Federica Proietto Salanitri, Concetto Spampinato, Giovanni Bellitto. CLIP has revolutionized zero-shot learning by enabling task generalization without fine-tuning. While prompting techniques like CoOp and CoCoOp enhance CLIP’s adaptability, their effectiveness in Federated Learning (FL) remains an open challenge. Existing federated prompt learning approaches, such as FedCoOp and FedTPG, improve performance but face generalization issues, high communication costs, and reliance on a central server, limiting scalability and privacy.

arxiv-2510-04143.title: Detecting Semantic Clones of Unseen Functionality
arxiv-2510-04143.creator: Konstantinos Kitsios, Francesco Sovrano, Earl T. Barr, Alberto Bacchelli
arxiv-2510-04143.description: Abstract Semantic code clone detection is the task of detecting whether two snippets of code implement the same functionality (e.g., Sort Array). Recently, many neural models achieved near-perfect performance on this task. These models seek to make inferences based on their training data.

arxiv-2512-13996.title: Sparsity-Controllable Dynamic Top- p p MoE for Large Foundation Model Pre-training
arxiv-2512-13996.creator: Can Jin, Hongwu Peng, Mingcan Xiang, Qixin Zhang, Xiangchi Yuan, Amit Hasan, Ohiremen Dibua, Yifan Gong, Yan Kang, Dimitris N. Metaxas, [-0.5ex] Nanyang Technological University
arxiv-2512-13996.description: Abstract Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures effectively scale model capacity by activating only a subset of experts for each input token. However, the standard Top- k k routing strategy imposes a uniform sparsity pattern that ignores the varying difficulty of tokens.

pmc-10604763.title: Hermetia illucens Fermented with Lactobacillus plantarum KCCM12757P Alleviates Dextran Sodium Sulfate-Induced Colitis in Mice
pmc-10604763.creator: Seok Jun Son, Ah-Ram Han, Mi Jeong Sung, Sun Mee Hong, Sang-Hee Lee
pmc-10604763.description: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) can severely affect humans and animals and is difficult to treat. Black soldier fly (Hermetia illucens; Hi) larvae (BSFL) are a sustainable source of protein. However, no studies exist on the antioxidant and anti-inflammatory functions of BSFL or fermented BSFL with respect to IBD.

pmc-11046678.title: The National Bowel Cancer Screening Programme: a service for the asymptomatic or a pathway acting as a safety net?
pmc-11046678.creator: Solange Serna, Tania Baldwin, Ajay Verma
pmc-11046678.description: nosed with CRC are still found to have advanced disease that is non-curable. We aim to evaluate the proportion of patients who attend BCSP who have symptoms suggestive of CRC.

pmc-11670000.title: Human milk microbiota and oligosaccharides in colostrum and mature milk: comparison and correlation
pmc-11670000.creator: Hongda Ge, Wenxiu Zhu, Jing Zhang, Zijing Wang, Huijing Shi, Jie Sun, Ming Shi
pmc-11670000.description: BackgroundThe interaction between the human breast milk microbiota and human milk oligosaccharides (HMOs) plays a crucial role in the healthy growth and development of infants. We aimed to clarify the link between the breast milk microbiota and HMOs at two stages of lactation.

pmc-11678505.title: Enhancing Amyloid PET Quantification: MRI-Guided Super-Resolution Using Latent Diffusion Models
pmc-11678505.creator: Jay Shah, Yiming Che, Javad Sohankar, Ji Luo, Baoxin Li, Yi Su, Teresa Wu, for the Alzheimer’s Disease Neuroimaging Initiative, Juraj Javor, Ivana Shawkatová
pmc-11678505.description: Amyloid PET imaging plays a crucial role in the diagnosis and research of Alzheimer’s disease (AD), allowing non-invasive detection of amyloid-β plaques in the brain. However, the low spatial resolution of PET scans limits the accurate quantification of amyloid deposition due to partial volume effects (PVE).

pmc-12525839.creator: Xinyan Xu, Mengmeng Feng, Tongwei Wei, Fei Pan, Liang Zhao, Lei Zhao, Lindsay Brown, Anna Ogrodowczyk, Lidia Markiewicz
pmc-12525839.description: The growing demand for sustainable and nutritionally balanced protein sources has intensified global interest in edible insects as an emerging alternative to conventional animal- and plant-based proteins. This review synthesizes current knowledge on insect proteins with a clear focus on four dimensions: nutritional value, functional properties, bioactivities, and safety considerations. pmc-12642293.title: Whole-genome analysis reveals genetic diversity and selection pressure in Sichuan donkey
pmc-12642293.creator: Cong Li, Jiale Han, Tingjin Chang, Halima Jafari, Qiwen Yang, Jiajun Guo, Chuzhao Lei, Ruihua Dang
pmc-12642293.description: BackgroundSichuan donkeys are small-statured donkeys native to the plateau and mountainous regions of southwestern China. They are well-suited for transportation tasks in mountainous terrain and exhibit remarkable adaptability to the harsh environment, characterized by low temperatures and hypoxia. Adaptation to the local environment has shaped their unique genomic characteristics and is an important source of genetic variation.

pmc-12670959.title: Are Insulin and Metformin Really Protective on Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis by Blocking the Astrocytic Cx43 Channel?
pmc-12670959.creator: Josef Finsterer
pmc-12670959.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). n study with Cx43 channels, which investigated whether insulin or metformin can dock within the Cx43 channel and effectively block it, thereby reducing the risk of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) [1]. Based on data from the FDA Med Watch, it was found that the insulin heterodimer docks in the center of the Cx43 channel and effectively blocks it, and that this blockade is very stable, thereby achieving a protective effect on ALS [1].

pmc-12735177.title: Pathological Characteristics of a Quail Model with Hyperuricemia Combined with Hyperlipidemia
pmc-12735177.creator: Shujia Liu, Xinyu Feng, Xinlong Liu, Yan Lin, Bing Zhang, Zhijian Lin, Yu Wang
pmc-12735177.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Objective: To explore the association between uric acid and the prevalence of hyperlipidemia via the NHANES database, a combined hyperuricemia–hyperlipidemia (HUA-HLP) quail model was subsequently established to investigate the pathological characteristics of the model. Methods: In the NHANES database, information on patients with hyperuricemia is collected, and the association between serum uric acid levels and the prevalence of hyperlipidemia is analyzed by adjusting for confounding variables.

pmc-12775111.title: The evolution toward integrated community health care for older people in Italy
pmc-12775111.creator: A Marengoni, A Zucchelli, A Padovani, E Belli, L Cajazzo, E Burato
pmc-12775111.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The progressive aging of the Italian population and the increasing prevalence of multimorbidity and frailty call for a reorganization of health and social care services. In this paper we aim to critically examine Ministerial Decree 77/2022, within Mission 6 of the National Recovery and Resilience Plan, which establishes new models and standards for community-based care and offers an unique opportunity to deliver care that is closer to people’s homes, fostering a holistic approach that combines clinical expertise, social support, and technological innovation.

pmc-12817712.title: Association of platelet-lymphocyte ratio with acute pancreatitis severity: systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12817712.creator: Mohamed Y Ibrahim, Mona M Alhaj, Abdelrahim Abdelrazig Ahmed Ibrahim, Malak Rabih, Maram Rabih Musa Rabih, Mohammed Elrayah Hassan Massaad, Abdelrahman K Elzubir, Mohammed Mansour Hassan Abdelrahman, Omer Afifeldin Elmusharf Abdelrahman, Sagad O O Mohamed
pmc-12817712.description: BackgroundAcute pancreatitis (AP) is an inflammatory disease with a heterogeneous clinical course, ranging from mild symptoms to life-threatening complications. The platelet-to-lymphocyte ratio (PLR), an easily accessible inflammatory biomarker, has shown prognostic value in other conditions but has been understudied in AP. This review aimed to systematically evaluate the association between PLR and AP severity.

pmc-13116616.title: The Pyrazole Scaffold in Anticancer Drug Discovery: A Review of Synthetic Approaches, Structure–Activity Relationships, and Target-Based Mechanism of Action
pmc-13116616.creator: Krishnapriya K R, Veda B. Hacholli, Marcin Gackowski, Dariusz Maciej Pisklak, Abhishek Kumar, Łukasz Szeleszczuk
pmc-13116616.description: Pyrazole derivatives have emerged as an important class of heterocyclic compounds in anticancer research due to their structural versatility and broad spectrum of biological activities. This review provides a concise overview of recent advances in the development of pyrazole-based anticancer agents, with emphasis on synthetic strategies, structure–activity relationships, and molecular mechanisms of action.

pmc-13585986.title: Exercise hemodynamics in adults with Fontan circulation assessed by noninvasive impedance cardiography
pmc-13585986.creator: Agnieszka Bartczak-Rutkowska, Ewa Straburzyńska-Migaj, Sonia Nartowicz, Magdalena Dudek, Aleksandra Ciepłucha, Agata Markiewicz, Maciej Lesiak, Olga Trojnarska
pmc-13585986.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundExercise intolerance is a hallmark of Fontan physiology despite preserved resting hemodynamics. The relative roles of stroke volume, chronotropic response, and vascular adaptation during exercise remain incompletely defined in adults with Fontan circulation.MethodsIn this prospective observational study, 27 adults with Fontan circulation were enrolled, of whom 22 with complete cardiopulmonary exercise testing (CPET) and impedance cardiography data were included in the final analysis. Twenty-five healthy controls underwent the same protocol.
